upstream_bundle.description: PhySense code, dataset, checkpoint, and reference points for Aerodynamics/CarAerodynamicsSensing.

observations: PhySense git_clone has no checkout revision; the upstream protocol fetches the current branch head.
Google Drive datasets and checkpoints have file-count/size checks but no declared upstream checksums.
Generated build manifests record actual fetched asset hashes. Explicit asset snapshots can preserve those bytes for reuse.
The upstream gdown/uvx path has a standard-library public-download fallback when uvx is unavailable.
Reference point extraction uses the frontier-v1-kernel Python alias; the adapter creates that alias before bootstrap.

kernels.note: No task asset bootstrap actions; runtime preflight still requires CUDA and imports torch/triton.
